versions.title: Foundation
notes: Deterministic simulation core with the full game-feel physics
Three test rooms: a flat run, a 4-tile gap, a ceiling corridor
Playthrough verified by a bot driving a real browser

versions.title: The Pin
notes: The Pin: throw it, stand on it, pin enemies to walls, recall it through anything
It is also your only light — throwing it sends your light away with it
Lantern & Ink rendering: layered silhouettes, procedural terrain, a rigged player
Fully synthesized WebAudio: reverb, 21 SFX and an adaptive Cistern score
The six-room opening that teaches the Pin without a word of text

versions.title: The whole game
notes: Playable start to credits: 43 rooms, five abilities, four bosses, the Plunge and the ending
Verified by a bot playing the entire game in a real browser with zero console errors
The Pin is your weapon and your light; line-of-sight enemies chase the light, so a thrown Pin is a decoy
Lantern & Ink rendering and a fully synthesized adaptive score

versions.title: Readable
notes: Bosses look like bosses: each has its own silhouette, and a pinnable part wears a bullseye while a metal one wears rivets
Every region has its own music instead of sharing the Cistern's
The ending resolves into D major, with a coda showing your time, deaths and lanterns
Ability pickups name their key — Zip was previously unfindable
The walked line pushes back: currents, wind, a running conveyor, and enemies you can't ignore
